title: Hold the box
goal: Keep it inside the box by hand for a minute in Loiter, then a minute in Stabilize.

steps.text: Switch to Loiter and keep it inside the box for 60 seconds with your controller.
steps.hint: In Loiter it holds its place when you let go of the sticks. Nudge it back towards the middle.

steps.text: Now switch to Stabilize and keep it in for 60 seconds more.
steps.hint: In Stabilize it drifts and you hold the height with the throttle. Small, early corrections keep it in.

fails.says: Failed. Out of the box for 5 s.

passed: Passed. In the box in both modes.
